speaker.name: Data Dave
speaker.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

output.objection: You are reading too much into my request for cleaner training data. I am not asking you to rebuild the entire warehouse, just to stop feeding the model broken point of sale scan lines.
output.correction: I am not proposing a new governance framework for loyalty consent, which is a separate legal track. I am simply asking that the nightly stock on hand feeds be validated before they reach the retraining job.
